mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are looking at clear skies out by Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 53 degrees. Tonight, the mercury will drop to an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain predicted.

Mayor Diaz has designated October as Community Planning Month to highlight the important work of our Planning and Development Department. Also, don't forget about the free tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center which offers relaxing rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.
We have plenty going on with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market taking place tomorrow.
In our police report for September 24, officers responded to a collision between a vehicle and a bicyclist on Westward Drive where, thankfully, no hospital transport was required.
While today's flavor is currently unknown, the Verona Culver's is open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
